description: Fork of exp252 with soft_use_bf16=false on TinyMHLut(soft). Forward stays at fp32 sign-bit-pack argmax (same as exp252). Backward recompute runs in fp32 too (no bf16 autocast). Tests whether fully-fp32 path drifts from exp251 the same way exp252 (fp32 fwd argmax + bf16 bwd) does. If yes, drift is intrinsic to fp32 argmax in forward. Memory is higher than bf16 due to fp32 transients during backward — feasible because TinyMHLut(soft) doesn't save big tensors across layers.
